newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends up nine cents on London's rise.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends up nine cents on London's rise.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed nine cents higher at 14.14 ringgit ($5.64) a kg, rebounding from Wednesday's fall as gains in London encouraged strong foreign demand, traders said.
They said tin price on the London Metal Exchange (LME) rose $50 a tonne in the last two days. The local market was closed on Thursday for Labour Day.
"There was strong buying from Europe and Japan," said one trader. He said LME's performance would continue to influence the price direction here.
Traders noted initial bids for 229 tonnes against offers for 113 tonnes. Final turnover was 148 tonnes, up from 110 on Wednesday.
The local price premium over LME has narrowed slightly to $90 a tonne from $100 previously, traders said.
